sentences.en: By architectural symmetry, Emmet means geometric symmetry combined with aesthetic uniformity.
sentences.zh: 通过建筑对称性，艾梅特的意思是几何对称与美学统一相结合。

sentences.en: Most of our business is derived from architectural competitions.
sentences.zh: 我们大部分业务来自建筑设计竞赛。

sentences.en: The Montparnasse Tower cannot be called an architectural success.
sentences.zh: 蒙帕纳斯塔无法被称为建筑上的成功。

senses.zh: 建筑学的;建筑上的；有关建筑的 - 符合建筑法的
